name: ddterm
summary: Drop-down (quake) terminal as a GNOME Shell extension, VTE-based with tabs, splits, per-edge position and size, animations, opacity and a command line / D-Bus control interface. Settings live in dconf, not in a file.
configFormat: dconf/gsettings (schema org.gnome.shell.extensions.ddterm, path /com/github/amezin/ddterm/), no config file

install.notes: Easiest route is https://extensions.gnome.org/extension/3780/ddterm/ (browser integration or the Extension Manager app); the site may lag the latest GitHub release. From a downloaded bundle: gnome-extensions install -f ddterm@amezin.github.com.shell-extension.zip (then it is not auto-updated).
Arch Linux AUR package; a binary repo is also described in docs/Install.md.

linux.notes: Requires GNOME Shell 48 to 51 (shell_versions in meson.build on master at the verified date); it is not a standalone app and does nothing on KDE, Sway or other desktops. No config file: all settings are dconf keys. The schema id is org.gnome.shell.extensions.ddterm (com.github.amezin.ddterm is the application id, not the settings schema). The schema ships inside the extension, not system-wide, so if gsettings reports No such schema, point it at the extension's schemas folder (for a per-user install, likely ~/.local/share/gnome-shell/extensions/ddterm@amezin.github.com/schemas, unverified) via GSETTINGS_SCHEMA_DIR, or write the same keys with `dconf write /com/github/amezin/ddterm/KEY VALUE`. Back up first with `dconf dump /com/github/amezin/ddterm/ > backup.ini`. Enable with `gnome-extensions enable ddterm@amezin.github.com`; after a first install GNOME Shell may need a log out and in. Requires a running dconf/D-Bus session of the desktop user. Control from the command line: `gapplication action com.github.amezin.ddterm toggle` (also show, hide).

background-image.notes: No background image key in the settings schema. Use Guake, kitty, WezTerm or Konsole.
